# Teljes Passkey-alapú Autentikációs Rendszer Implementációja

## Rendszeráttekintés

Építs fel egy teljes, production-ready passkey-alapú autentikációs rendszert, amely WebAuthn protokollt használ, email/SMS OTP verifikációt támogat, social login integrációt biztosít, és session management funkcionalitást nyújt. A rendszer backend része egyetlen Scopes programnyelv fájlban implementálandó, a frontend pedig tiszta HTML, CSS és JavaScript használatával.[1]

## Backend Implementáció (Scopes nyelven, egyetlen fájl)

### 1. Projekt Struktúra és Konfiguráció

#### 5.3 JWT Parsing és Validálás
Implementálj JWT token parsing és validálási logikát:[1]
```scopes
struct JWTHeader {
    alg: string
    typ: string
    kid: string
}

struct JWTClaims {
    iss: string (issuer)
    sub: string (subject - user ID)
    aud: string (audience - project ID, opcionális)
    exp: int64 (expiration time)
    nbf: int64 (not before)
    iat: int64 (issued at)
    jti: string (JWT ID, opcionális)
    # Custom claims
    name: string (opcionális)
    email: string (opcionális)
    orig: string (opcionális)
}

fn parse-jwt (token: string) -> Result<(JWTHeader, JWTClaims, string), string>
    # Splits a tokent 3 részre: header.payload.signature
    # Base64 URL dekódolás mindegyikre
    # Parse-old a header-t és claims-t JSON-ként
    # Térj vissza a struktúrákkal és az eredeti payload string-gel

fn validate-jwt-signature (
    token: string,
    header: JWTHeader,
    payload-string: string,
    signature: bytes
) -> Result<bool, string>
    # Szerezz JWKA kulcsot a header.kid alapján
    # Konstruáld az aláírandó üzenetet: "{header-base64}.{payload-base64}"
    # Ellenőrizd az aláírást

fn validate-jwt-claims (claims: JWTClaims) -> Result<(), string>
    # Ellenőrizd az exp claim-et (ne legyen lejárt)
    # Ellenőrizd az nbf claim-et (ne legyen jövőbeli)
    # Ellenőrizd az iss claim-et (egyezzen a FRONTEND_API_URL-lel)
    # Ha mindegyik érvényes, térj vissza Ok-val

fn validate-session-token (token: string) -> Result<JWTClaims, string>
    let (header, claims, payload-str) = (try (parse-jwt token))
    let signature-bytes = (try (base64-url-decode signature))
    try (validate-jwt-signature token header payload-str signature-bytes)
    try (validate-jwt-claims claims)
    Ok claims
```

#### 5.4 JWT Generálás (Session Token)
Implementálj JWT token generálást RS256 algoritmussal:[1]
```scopes
# Feltételezzük, hogy van egy private key RSA formátumban
global jwt-private-key: RSAPrivateKey
global jwt-key-id: string

fn generate-session-token (
    user-id: string,
    session-id: string,
    expires-at: int64
) -> Result<string, string>
    let now = (current-timestamp-seconds)
    let header = (JWTHeader
        alg: "RS256"
        typ: "JWT"
        kid: jwt-key-id)
    let claims = (JWTClaims
        iss: JWT_ISSUER
        sub: user-id
        exp: expires-at
        nbf: now
        iat: now
        jti: session-id)
    let header-json = (serialize-json header)
    let claims-json = (serialize-json claims)
    let header-b64 = (base64-url-encode (string->bytes header-json))
    let claims-b64 = (base64-url-encode (string->bytes claims-json))
    let message = .. header-b64 "." claims-b64
    let signature = (try (rsa-sign (string->bytes message) jwt-private-key))
    let signature-b64 = (base64-url-encode signature)
    Ok (.. message "." signature-b64)
```

#### 6.2 WebAuthn Registration (Passkey Append)
Implementálj passkey regisztrációs flow-t:[1]

**Start Passkey Append**
```scopes
fn start-passkey-append (user-id: string) -> Result<PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions, string>
    # Szerezd meg a user-t az ID alapján
    let user = (try (get-user user-id))
    # Generálj 32 byte véletlenszerű challenge-t
    let challenge = (generate-random-bytes 32)
    # Tárolj el egy ideiglenes challenge record-ot (TTL: 5 perc)
    # Szerezd meg a user összes passkey credential ID-ját az excludeCredentials-hez
    let existing-creds = (get-passkeys-by-user user-id)
    let exclude-list = (map existing-creds (fn (cred) 
        struct {
            type: "public-key"
            id: cred.credentialID
            transports: cred.transport
        }))
    # Konstruáld a creation options-t
    Ok (PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions
        rp: struct { id: RP_ID, name: RP_NAME }
        user: struct {
            id: (string->bytes user-id)
            name: (get-primary-identifier user-id)
            displayName: user.fullName
        }
        challenge: challenge
        pubKeyCredParams: [
            struct { type: "public-key", alg: -7 }   # ES256
            struct { type: "public-key", alg: -257 } # RS256
        ]
        timeout: 60000
        attestation: "none"
        authenticatorSelection: struct {
            residentKey: "required"
            userVerification: "required"

```

**Finish Passkey Append**
```scopes
struct AttestationObject {
    fmt: string
    authData: bytes
    attStmt: map<string, any>
}

struct AuthenticatorData {
    rpIdHash: bytes (32 bytes, SHA-256 hash of RP ID)
    flags: byte (bit 0: UP, bit 2: UV, bit 6: AT, bit 7: ED)
    signCount: uint32
    attestedCredentialData: Option<struct {
        aaguid: bytes (16 bytes)
        credentialIdLength: uint16
        credentialId: bytes
        credentialPublicKey: bytes (COSE format)
    }>
    extensions: Option<bytes>
}

fn parse-authenticator-data (data: bytes) -> Result<AuthenticatorData, string>
    # Parse-old az authenticator data struktúrát a WebAuthn spec szerint
    # Ellenőrizd a rpIdHash-t (egyezzen a SHA-256(RP_ID)-vel)
    # Ellenőrizd a flags-t (UP és UV bitnek állítva kell lennie)
    # Ha AT bit állítva van, parse-old az attested credential data-t

fn verify-attestation (
    attestation-obj: AttestationObject,
    client-data-json: bytes,
    expected-challenge: bytes
) -> Result<(), string>
    # Parse-old a client data JSON-t
    # Ellenőrizd a type mezőt ("webauthn.create")
    # Ellenőrizd a challenge-t (base64url dekódolás után)
    # Ellenőrizd az origin-t (egyezzen az engedélyezett origin-nel)
    # Parse-old az authenticator data-t
    # Ellenőrizd az attestation format-ot (támogatott: "none", "packed", "fido-u2f")
    # Ha fmt != "none", végezz attestation verification-t

fn finish-passkey-append (
    user-id: string,
    credential-id: bytes,
    client-data-json: bytes,
    attestation-object: bytes
) -> Result<PasskeyCredential, string>
    # Szerezd meg az elmentett challenge-t
    # Parse-old az attestation object-et (CBOR dekódolás)
    let att-obj = (try (cbor-decode attestation-object))
    # Ellenőrizd az attestation-t
    try (verify-attestation att-obj client-data-json expected-challenge)
    # Parse-old az authenticator data-t
    let auth-data = (try (parse-authenticator-data att-obj.authData))
    # Hozz létre egy új PasskeyCredential record-ot
    let credential = (PasskeyCredential
        id: (generate-id "cre")
        userID: user-id
        credentialID: credential-id
        publicKey: auth-data.attestedCredentialData.credentialPublicKey
        aaguid: auth-data.attestedCredentialData.aaguid
        signCount: auth-data.signCount
        attestationType: att-obj.fmt
        transport: [] # A kliens fogja megadni
        backupState: (check-backup-flag auth-data.flags)
        created: (current-timestamp)
        lastUsed: (current-timestamp)
        status: "active"
        deviceInfo: struct {}) # Parse-old a User-Agent-ből
    # Mentsd el a credential-t az adatbázisba
    (save-passkey-credential credential)
    Ok credential
```

#### 6.3 WebAuthn Authentication (Passkey Login)
Implementálj passkey bejelentkezési flow-t:[1]

**Start Passkey Login**
```scopes
fn start-passkey-login (login-identifier: Option<string>) -> Result<PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions, string>
    let challenge = (generate-random-bytes 32)
    # Tárolj el egy ideiglenes challenge record-ot
    let allow-creds = 
        match login-identifier
            case Some ident =>
                # Szerezd meg a user-t az identifier alapján
                let user = (try (get-user-by-identifier ident))
                # Szerezd meg a user összes passkey-ét
                let creds = (get-passkeys-by-user user.id)
                (map creds (fn (c) struct {
                    type: "public-key"
                    id: c.credentialID
                    transports: c.transport
                }))
            case None =>
                # Conditional UI: üres allowCredentials lista
                []
    Ok (PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions
        challenge: challenge
        timeout: 60000
        rpId: RP_ID
        allowCredentials: allow-creds
        userVerification: "required")
```

**Finish Passkey Login**
```scopes
struct AuthenticatorAssertionResponse {
    clientDataJSON: bytes
    authenticatorData: bytes
    signature: bytes
    userHandle: bytes (opcionális)
}

fn verify-assertion (
    credential-id: bytes,
    client-data-json: bytes,
    authenticator-data: bytes,
    signature: bytes,
    expected-challenge: bytes
) -> Result<string, string> # Visszatér a user ID-val
    # Szerezd meg a passkey credential-t a credential-id alapján
    let credential = (try (get-passkey-by-credential-id credential-id))
    # Parse-old a client data JSON-t
    let client-data = (try (parse-json client-data-json))
    # Ellenőrizd a type mezőt ("webauthn.get")
    # Ellenőrizd a challenge-t
    # Ellenőrizd az origin-t
    # Parse-old az authenticator data-t
    let auth-data = (try (parse-authenticator-data authenticator-data))
    # Ellenőrizd a rpIdHash-t
    # Ellenőrizd a flags-t (UP és UV bitnek állítva kell lennie)
    # Ellenőrizd a signCount-ot (ne legyen kisebb mint az eltárolt érték)
    # Konstruáld a signed data-t: authenticatorData || SHA-256(clientDataJSON)
    let client-data-hash = (sha256 client-data-json)
    let signed-data = (concat authenticator-data client-data-hash)
    # Ellenőrizd az aláírást a credential.publicKey-jel
    let valid = (try (verify-cose-signature signed-data signature credential.publicKey))
    if (not valid)
        return (Err "Invalid signature")
    # Frissítsd a signCount-ot és lastUsed-et
    (update-passkey-sign-count credential.id auth-data.signCount)
    Ok credential.userID

fn finish-passkey-login (
    credential-id: bytes,
    assertion: AuthenticatorAssertionResponse
) -> Result<(string, string), string> # (user-id, session-token)
    # Ellenőrizd az assertion-t
    let user-id = (try (verify-assertion 
        credential-id
        assertion.clientDataJSON
        assertion.authenticatorData
        assertion.signature
        expected-challenge))
    # Hozz létre egy új session-t
    let session = (try (create-session user-id))
    # Generálj session token-t (JWT)
    let token = (try (generate-session-token user-id session.id session.expires))
    Ok (user-id, token)
```

fn refresh-session (
    session-token: string

fn require-backend-api-auth (request: HTTPRequest) -> Result<(), HTTPResponse>
    let auth-header = (get-header request "Authorization")
    match auth-header
        case None =>
            Err (http-response 401 "Unauthorized" "Missing Authorization header")
        case Some header =>
            if (not (starts-with header "Basic "))
                return (Err (http-response 401 "Unauthorized" "Invalid auth scheme"))
            let credentials = (try (base64-decode (substring header 6)))
            let parts = (split credentials ":")
            if (!= (length parts) 2)
                return (Err (http-response 401 "Unauthorized" "Invalid credentials format"))
            let [username, password] = parts
            if (or (!= username PROJECT_ID) (!= password API_SECRET))
                return (Err (http-response 401 "Unauthorized" "Invalid credentials"))
            Ok ()

fn route-request (request: HTTPRequest) -> HTTPResponse
    let method = request.method
    let path = request.path
    
    # Backend API routes
    if (starts-with path "/v2/")
        match (method, path)
            # Users
            case ("POST", "/v2/users") => (handle-create-user request)
            case ("GET", (regex "/v2/users/([^/]+)$" [user-id])) => (handle-get-user request user-id)
            case ("GET", "/v2/users") => (handle-list-users request)
            case ("PATCH", (regex "/v2/users/([^/]+)$" [user-id])) => (handle-update-user request user-id)
            case ("DELETE", (regex "/v2/users/([^/]+)$" [user-id])) => (handle-delete-user request user-id)
            
            # Identifiers
            case ("POST", (regex "/v2/users/([^/]+)/identifiers$" [user-id])) => 
                (handle-create-identifier request user-id)
            case ("GET", "/v2/identifiers") => (handle-list-identifiers request)
            case ("PATCH", (regex "/v2/users/([^/]+)/identifiers/([^/]+)$" [user-id, identifier-id])) =>
                (handle-update-identifier request user-id identifier-id)
            case ("DELETE", (regex "/v2/users/([^/]+)/identifiers/([^/]+)$" [user-id, identifier-id])) =>
                (handle-delete-identifier request user-id identifier-id)
            
            # Passkeys
            case ("GET", (regex "/v2/users/([^/]+)/credentials$" [user-id])) =>
                (handle-list-passkeys request user-id)
            case ("DELETE", (regex "/v2/users/([^/]+)/credentials/([^/]+)$" [user-id, cred-id])) =>
                (handle-delete-passkey request user-id cred-id)
            case ("POST", "/v2/passkey/append/start") => (handle-backend-passkey-append-start request)
            case ("POST", "/v2/passkey/append/finish") => (handle-backend-passkey-append-finish request)
            case ("POST", "/v2/passkey/login/start") => (handle-backend-passkey-login-start request)
            case ("POST", "/v2/passkey/login/finish") => (handle-backend-passkey-login-finish request)
            case ("POST", "/v2/passkey/verifySignedData") => (handle-verify-signed-passkey-data request)
            
            # Challenges
            case ("POST", (regex "/v2/users/([^/]+)/challenges$" [user-id])) =>
                (handle-create-challenge request user-id)
            case ("PATCH", (regex "/v2/users/([^/]+)/challenges/([^/]+)$" [user-id, challenge-id])) =>
                (handle-update-challenge request user-id challenge-id)
            
            # Sessions
            case ("GET", "/v2/sessions") => (handle-list-sessions request)
            case ("POST", (regex "/v2/sessions/([^/]+)/revoke$" [session-id])) =>
                (handle-revoke-session request session-id)
            
            # Connect Tokens
            case ("POST", "/v2/connectTokens") => (handle-create-connect-token request)
            case ("GET", "/v2/connectTokens") => (handle-list-connect-tokens request)
            case ("PATCH", (regex "/v2/connectTokens/([^/]+)$" [token-id])) =>
                (handle-update-connect-token request token-id)
            case ("DELETE", (regex "/v2/connectTokens/([^/]+)$" [token-id])) =>
                (handle-delete-connect-token request token-id)
            
            # Social Accounts
            case ("POST", (regex "/v2/users/([^/]+)/socialAccounts$" [user-id])) =>

struct RateLimitBucket {
    requestCount: int
    windowStart: int64
}

global rate-limit-buckets: HashMap<string, RateLimitBucket> = (hashmap-new)

const RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS: int = 2000
const RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS: int = 10

fn check-rate-limit (ip: string) -> Result<(), APIError>
    let now = (current-timestamp)
    match (hashmap-get rate-limit-buckets ip)
        case None =>
            # Első request ettől az IP-től
            (hashmap-set rate-limit-buckets ip (RateLimitBucket {
                requestCount: 1
                windowStart: now
            }))
            Ok ()
        case Some bucket =>
            let window-elapsed = (- now bucket.windowStart)
            if (> window-elapsed RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS)
                # Új window indítása
                (hashmap-set rate-limit-buckets ip (RateLimitBucket {
                    requestCount: 1
                    windowStart: now
                }))
                Ok ()
            else
                # Ugyanabban a window-ban vagyunk
                if (>= bucket.requestCount RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS)
                    Err (api-error rate_limited "Rate limit exceeded. Max 2000 requests per 10 seconds.")
                else
                    (hashmap-set rate-limit-buckets ip (RateLimitBucket {
                        requestCount: (+ bucket.requestCount 1)
                        windowStart: bucket.windowStart
                    }))
                    Ok ()

fn rate-limit-middleware (request: HTTPRequest) -> Result<(), HTTPResponse>
    let ip = (get-client-ip request)
    match (check-rate-limit ip)
        case Ok () => Ok ()
        case Err error => Err (error-response error)

fn cleanup-rate-limit-buckets () -> ()
    # Periodikusan tisztítsd meg a régi bucket-eket
    let now = (current-timestamp)
    let cutoff = (- now (* 2 RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS))
    (hashmap-retain rate-limit-buckets (fn (ip, bucket)
        (> bucket.windowStart cutoff)))

struct QueryParams {
    page: int
    pageSize: int
    sort: Option<SortParams>
    filters: array<FilterParams>
}

struct SortParams {
    field: string
    direction: string # "asc" or "desc"
}

struct FilterParams {
    field: string
    operator: string # "eq", "ne", "gt", "lt", "gte", "lte", "contains", "in"
    value: any
}

struct ListResult<T> {
    items: array<T>
    total: int
    page: int
    pageSize: int
}

fn parse-query-params (request: HTTPRequest) -> QueryParams
    let page = (parse-int-or (get-query-param request "page") 1)
    let page-size = (parse-int-or (get-query-param request "pageSize") 20)
    let sort = (parse-sort-param request)
    let filters = (parse-filter-params request)
    QueryParams {
        page: page
        pageSize: page-size
        sort: sort
        filters: filters
    }

fn parse-sort-param (request: HTTPRequest) -> Option<SortParams>
    match (get-query-param request "sort")
        case None => None
        case Some sort-str =>
            if (starts-with sort-str "-")
                Some (SortParams {
                    field: (substring sort-str 1 None)
                    direction: "desc"
                })
            else
                Some (SortParams {
                    field: sort-str
                    direction: "asc"
                })

fn parse-filter-params (request: HTTPRequest) -> array<FilterParams>
    # Parse filter query params (e.g., ?filter=status:eq:active&filter=created:gt:1234567890)
    # Implementációs részletek...
    []

fn apply-filters<T> (items: array<T>, filters: array<FilterParams>) -> array<T>
    (fold filters items (fn (acc, filter)
        (filter acc (fn (item)
            (apply-filter-predicate item filter)))))

fn apply-filter-predicate<T> (item: T, filter: FilterParams) -> bool
    let field-value = (get-field-value item filter.field)
    match filter.operator
        case "eq" => (= field-value filter.value)
        case "ne" => (!= field-value filter.value)
        case "gt" => (> field-value filter.value)
        case "lt" => (< field-value filter.value)
        case "gte" => (>= field-value filter.value)
        case "lte" => (<= field-value filter.value)
        case "contains" => (contains-str field-value filter.value)
        case "in" => (contains filter.value field-value)
        case _ => true

fn apply-sorting<T> (items: array<T>, sort: Option<SortParams>) -> array<T>
    match sort
        case None => items
        case Some params =>
            let sorted = (sort-by items (fn (item)
                (get-field-value item params.field)))
            if (= params.direction "desc")
                (reverse sorted)
            else
                sorted

fn apply-pagination<T> (items: array<T>, page: int, page-size: int) -> array<T>
    let start = (* (- page 1) page-size)
    let end = (+ start page-size)
    (slice items start end)

                list.appendChild(item);

                    const id = e.target.dataset.id;
                    if (confirm('Biztosan törölni szeretnéd ezt az azonosítót?')) {
                        try {
                            await API.deleteCurrentUserIdentifier(id);
                            await loadProfileData();
                            UI.showSuccess('Azonosító törölve');

                            UI.showError('Hiba történt az azonosító törlése során');

                window.location.href = 'login.html';
                return;
            }

            await loadPasskeys();

            // Add passkey button
            document.getElementById('add-passkey-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
                try {
                    UI.showLoading('Passkey létrehozása...');
                    
                    // Start passkey append
                    const startResponse = await API.startCurrentUserPasskeyAppend();
                    
                    // Create credential
                    const credential = await WebAuthnClient.createCredential(startResponse);
                    
                    // Finish passkey append
                    await API.finishCurrentUserPasskeyAppend(credential);
                    
                    UI.hideLoading();
                    UI.showSuccess('Passkey sikeresen létrehozva');
                    await loadPasskeys();
                } catch (error) {
                    UI.hideLoading();
                    UI.showError('Hiba történt a passkey létrehozása során: ' + error.message);
                }
            });
        });

        async function loadPasskeys() {
            try {
                const passkeys = await API.listCurrentUserPasskeys();
                renderPasskeys(passkeys);
            } catch (error) {
                UI.showError('Hiba történt a passkey-ek betöltése során');
            }
        }

        function renderPasskeys(passkeys) {
            const container = document.getElementById('passkeys-list-container');
            
            if (passkeys.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<p class="empty-state">Még nincs passkey-ed. Hozz létre egyet a biztonságosabb bejelentkezéshez!</p>';
                return;
            }

            container.innerHTML = '';
            passkeys.forEach(passkey => {
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = 'passkey-item';
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="passkey-info">
                        <div class="passkey-icon">${getPasskeyIcon(passkey.deviceInfo)}</div>
                        <div class="passkey-details">
                            <div class="passkey-name">${getPasskeyName(passkey.deviceInfo)}</div>
                            <div class="passkey-metadata">
                                <span>Létrehozva: ${formatDate(passkey.created)}</span>
                                <span>Utoljára használva: ${formatDate(passkey.lastUsed)}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <button class="btn btn-danger delete-passkey" data-id="${passkey.id}">
                        Törlés
                    </button>
                `;
                container.appendChild(item);
            });

            // Add delete handlers
            container.querySelectorAll('.delete-passkey').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
                    const id = e.target.dataset.id;
                    if (confirm('Biztosan törölni szeretnéd ezt a passkey-t?')) {
                        try {
                            await API.deleteCurrentUserPasskey(id);
                            await loadPasskeys();
                            UI.showSuccess('Passkey törölve');
                        } catch (error) {
                            UI.showError('Hiba történt a passkey törlése során');
                        }
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        function getPasskeyIcon(deviceInfo) {
            if (deviceInfo.osName.includes('Windows')) return '💻';
            if (deviceInfo.osName.includes('Mac')) return '🍎';
            if (deviceInfo.osName.includes('Android')) return '🤖';
            if (deviceInfo.osName.includes('iOS')) return '📱';
            return '🔑';
        }

        function getPasskeyName(deviceInfo) {
            return `${deviceInfo.browserName} on ${deviceInfo.osName}`;
        }

        function formatDate(timestamp) {
            const date = new Date(timestamp);
            return date.toLocaleDateString('hu-HU', { 
                year: 'numeric', 
                month: 'long', 
                day: 'numeric' 
            });
        }
    </script>
